scope: Runtime language logic with host SDK/storage adapters
checks: System default, resources and round-trip switch
Native stages, task status, report limitations and degradation labels follow the app language
Persistence across process adapters and system-language override
Listeners unsubscribe and same-language selection is inert
Override resource managers are cached per locale; application language waits for loaded window
Active and completed tasks retain keys, timing, names and detached arguments
Selector refresh preserves route, consent, user name, quality and error state
Pending preview confirmation rebuilds in the new language without submission
